# Smaply

> > Smaply is a journey management platform that enables teams to create, evaluate, and operationalize customer journey maps with integrations to Jira, Asana, PowerBI, and other enterprise tools.

Smaply helps organizations transition from journey mapping to journey management through collaborative tools, multi-industry solutions (fashion, government, SaaS), and seamless integrations with project management and analytics platforms. The platform supports service design methodologies and CX operations with features for both current-state and future-state journey visualization.

## Key Topics

- Customer Journey Mapping
- Journey Management
- Service Design
- Customer Experience (CX)
- CX Operations
- Journey Map Evaluation
- Current-State vs Future-State Maps
- Integrations (Jira, Asana, PowerBI, Azure DevOps)
- Experience Research
- UX Design
- Design Thinking
- CX Maturity
- Omnichannel Experience
- Journey Map Elements
- Accessibility (A11Y)

- [Journey map elements: what to include and why](https://www.smaply.com/blog/journey-map-elements): Essential journey map components: stages, touchpoints, emotions explained
- [How to evaluate a Customer Journey Map | Smaply Blog](https://www.smaply.com/blog/journey-map-evaluation): Guide to evaluating journey maps: validation, reliability, current vs future
- [Current vs. future state journey maps | Smaply](https://www.smaply.com/blog/current-vs-future-state-journey-maps): Current-state vs future-state journey maps: differences and guide
